item.title: The 90-Day Blueprint to Becoming a Full-Stack Developer: From Zero to AI-Powered Apps
item.description:
Ninety days sounds tight. If you ask ten senior engineers how long it takes to become job-ready, most will say a year or two. They aren’t lying, but they are assuming traditional computer science degree timelines or casual self-study. If you cut out the noise, focus on production-grade tools, and ship real projects every single week, three months is plenty of time to build a formidable foundation.

This blueprint breaks down the exact 90-day trajectory. We start with raw web fundamentals, move into modern frontend architectures, build scalable backends, automate infrastructure with DevOps, and wrap up by wiring AI intelligence directly into full-stack applications.

item.title: Understanding YouTube Bookmarklets: How They Work, Security Risks, and Modern Alternatives
item.description:
Understanding YouTube Bookmarklets: How They Work, Security Risks, and Modern Alternatives

In the earlier days of the web—and still among power users today—bookmarklets offered a clever, lightweight way to extend browser functionality without installing heavy extensions. item.title: Building an Automated eGramSwaraj Data Extractor: Streamlining Municipal Audit Workflows
item.description:
Building an Automated eGramSwaraj Data Extractor: Streamlining Municipal Audit Workflows

Introduction

Conducting financial audits across local governance bodies—such as Gram Panchayats and Urban Local Bodies—often presents a classic data management bottleneck: portals like eGramSwaraj house thousands of crucial expenditure vouchers, payment records, and development scheme allocations, but extracting this data into structured formats for audit sampling can be tedious and prone to manual error.

To solve this, we developed a lightweight, client-side JavaScript extraction script that hooks directly into the browser DOM while inspecting eGramSwaraj data views. This tool automates the aggregation of voucher numbers, dates, beneficiary details, payment amounts, and scheme heads, exporting everything into clean, standardized CSV files ready for audit analysis.
